title: backend: dmabuf: ensure primary render node is preffered
body:
After dmabuf-v6 support in #2513, `update_default_feedback()` adds every non-primary GPU using `add_preference_tranche()`. Smithay intentionally places those tranches before the implicit main tranche.
As a result, the current default feedback ordering is
```
secondary 1
secondary 2
primary
```

and not the desired

```
primary
secondary 1
secondary 2
```
For v6 clients, secondary GPU becomes the first/default Sampling device even though `cosmic-comp` selected another GPU as `primary_node`.
On my AMD iGPU + RTX 4060 laptop, before this fix `cosmic-panel`, `cosmic-workspaces` and EGL clients selected NVIDIA by default. 

After the fix, applications now select the integrated GPU again, matching the behavior before the dmabuf-v6 update.
